lanes.title: Performance and autonomy harness
lanes.note: The long-job API does not exist; the handoff lists it as P2. Command timeouts clamp 100 ms to 30 s today.
lanes.scope_this_wave: editor-free: measurement design, benchmark harness written for the integrator to run, results schema, and the long-job design against the real constraint (serialized game thread, NOT_THREAD_SAFE, AcceptCommand refuses a concurrent command). Told not to implement a progress API that cannot report progress.
lanes.result: Merged. Central result is a reasoned NO: progress and cancellation are not achievable without changing the command queue, because FJsEnvImpl::UvRunOnce runs uv_run on the game thread, so a status query is never even read off the pipe while a long native call holds it. Shipped no progress API, specified the change required, recommended next_offset paging as the first real step. Benchmark harness written for the integrator; refusal path proven end to end. 26 editor-free checks.

long_job_verdict.reason: FJsEnvImpl::UvRunOnce runs uv_run on the game thread. While a long native call holds that thread the pipe is never read, so a job_status query is not merely refused by the active-command guard, it is never received until the work it asks about has finished. No client-side or TypeScript change can work around a blocked game thread.
